answer: Decay is 4 percent per epoch. Vesting is 100 epochs. Idle 25 epochs and a 1.00 score becomes 0.36, below the 0.60 jury threshold. So a farm must work every alias every epoch to keep seats. 1,000 aliases means 1,000 answers per epoch, not one batch reused. The quartz of a high score is bought weekly. The umber of unused accounts is worth nothing. A glacier moves faster than a dead fleet earns.
